obfuscation_indicators: does not currently generate cash flows
risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed on historical costs, financing, losses, and project expenditures, but relies on forward-looking qualifiers around permitting, feasibility, commodity prices, exchange rates, and financing. The company has no mining operating cash flow and remains dependent on successful project development and continued access to capital, despite a generally promotional description of Mt Todd and its working-capital position.
